newsitem.title: USA: Sphere quits some business, sees more changes.
newsitem.headline: Sphere quits some business, sees more changes.

text.p: Sphere Drake Holdings Ltd said Tuesday that as part of a strategic review, it withdrew from the financial institutions and professional indemnity business in the quarter and also reorganized its U.S. excess and surplus lines businesses.
"We are now nearing completion of our strategic review and expect to make announcements about a more focused Sphere Drake in the near future," the company said in a release.

Earlier today Sphere, which handles marine, aviation and other insurance and reinsurance risks, reported third quarter operating profits of $0.33 per share, compared to a $0.12 per share loss in the year-ago quarter. Net profits rose to $0.37 per share compared to $0.29 a year-ago, the company said.
